hypothesis: Preserve MR40 natural exits and vary only admission-confirmation and the fraction of cash deployed at entry. Test whether volatility targeting and account drawdown throttling retain most baseline return while reducing drawdown. Prior ATR brackets cut recovery trades; do not expand the RR search.
sizing: At an admitted entry decision j, fraction=min(case amount, vol_target/observed annual volatility if positive, dd_scale if closed account drawdown >= dd_threshold). All caps combine by minimum, not product. Volatility is population standard deviation of the last 180 closed log returns including j, multiplied by sqrt(365.25*6). Drawdown is measured from this account's prior closed-equity peak to its closed equity at j. Before the account starts, both are initial capital. Only source data and account marks at j are used even with two-bar execution lag. Never rebalance while holding; no leverage, adds or averaging down.
execution: Unchanged MR40 and Momentum30 admission; optional confirm3. Original natural exit at Z>=0. Use prior desired-target latency semantics identical to the frozen control; next open with 1- or 2-bar lag. Fees/slippage and venue lot/minimum match prior study. Terminal liquidation is explicit. No stops or profit targets are added.
selection: Use the unchanged pinned v2 profit and efficiency selectors on training 10000 only. Exclude baseline_a50 from selection. Profit requires normal PnL >= baseline, stress PnL >=1.05*positive baseline stress PnL (positive if baseline nonpositive), worst DD <=1.10*baseline; maximize stress PnL. Efficiency requires positive stress CAGR, normal CAGR >=0.75*positive baseline CAGR, worst DD <=baseline and score >=1.10*positive baseline score; maximize min(normal CAGR,stress CAGR)/max(normal DD,stress DD). Otherwise retain baseline. Ties use listed order. Evaluation requirements remain unchanged, including 75% PnL retention and 20% lower normal DD for efficiency. Never retune after results.
validation: 594 main runs: 264 Bybit main-window, 264 anchored train/test walk-forward, 66 LBank. Independent Decimal cashflow and sizing oracle; 36 frozen-control parity comparisons, 66 prefix checks. Six anchored folds select only from their past; geometrically compound independently liquidated fold accounts. Reuse verified input frames, no new exchange calls.

training_diagnostic.definition: Low from entry bar through last held bar before open exit, divided by entry reference; excludes exit-open bar and ignores costs. Training-only diagnostic, not a traded fill.

classification: Adaptive follow-up chosen after observing earlier studies. All history has already been seen; this is retrospective parameter research, not unseen-data qualification. Eleven paths and overlapping windows are not independent market samples.
